Definition: Magog, a son of Japheth; also a barbarous northern region
BiblicalUsage: Magog = "land of Gog"; n pr m; 1) the 2nd son of Japheth, grandson of Noah, and progenitor of several tribes northward from Israel; n pr loc; 2) the mountainous region between Cappadocia and Media and habitation of the descendants of Magog, son of Japheth and grandson of Noah
